name: twist push up
description: A push up with a rotation at the top. It trains the chest and arms and adds core work.
instructions: Set one hand on a sturdy bench and the other on the floor, then step back into a plank with your hips level.
Bend both elbows to lower your chest between the two supports.
Press up and rotate your upper body toward the bench side, reaching that arm upward only as far as you can control.
Return the hand to the bench, complete the set, then switch sides.
